system.description:
Rapidly rusting acid. A hit Target takes d6 damage, plus Burning (Cd6) if made of metal. If the Target is a non-Relic, the acid destroys a 1' circle of it down 1-inch deep, causing the following if it is Armor or a Weapon:

  • Armor is reduced by 1, breaking at 0.
  • Weapons reduce their damage die by one size until repaired. If the damage die is a d4 when this happens, it is destroyed.
